> 第17章 根基（第1页）
“师娘，我们以前是怎么洗澡的啊？”柳大春傻笑着问道。
“不是吧，那肯定是我不懂事了，师娘，我给你搓搓澡吧。”柳大春故意说道。
“啊？你这傻徒儿，怎么突然孝敬起师娘来了？好吧，你给师娘搓搓。”师娘杨桃花说着，把身子侧了过去，背对着柳大春。
柳大春趴了过去，伸手给师娘搓起澡来，先是搓着肩膀，然后一直往下搓。
师娘杨桃花叫了一声，回头看了傻徒儿一眼，问道：“傻徒儿，你往哪搓呢？”
“啊？都搓搓干净啊。”柳大春回答道。
“你搓师娘后背就行了。”师娘杨桃花回答道。
“哦，后面搓搓，前面也搓搓，前面也搓搓。”柳大春说着，又继续搓了起来。
师娘杨桃花转过身来，看着柳大春，问道：“傻大春，你不会是故意的吧？”
“啊？故意啥啊？”柳大春急忙装傻道。
“呵呵，你不会对女人有兴趣了吧？”师娘杨桃花笑着问道。
“嗯，我喜欢搓师娘这里，嘻嘻。”柳大春当即就直接承认了，反正自己是个傻子，师娘不会怪自己的。
“你个傻子，不会是长大了吧？”师娘杨桃花说着，看了看，还是一脸失望的笑了：“还是个傻子，搓后背吧，不许搓前面了，讨厌的。”
“师娘为啥不能搓前面啊？”柳大春假装不理解的问。
“等你哪天是男人了，你就懂了。”师娘杨桃花笑着说道。
吴坤那个王八蛋，把自己害成这样，此仇非报不可。
嗯，晚上全部精力都要修炼正阳之气了，定然能恢复过来，不然连师娘都对自己没有丝毫兴趣了。
想到这些，柳大春想死的心都有了，有心无力啊。

柳大春早早洗了澡，把大木桶扛了回去，然后回了自己的房间。
柳大春和师娘杨桃花的房间是连在一起的，中间用门帘遮掩着。
“傻徒儿，你今晚不和师娘一起睡吗？”师娘杨桃花穿了一身睡裙，展露着婀娜多姿的丰满身材。
“嗯，师娘，我今晚还有事，我就隔壁房间自己睡了。”柳大春想着，恢复不了男人阳，和师娘一起睡只会是一种煎熬。
“那行吧，你也长大了。”师娘杨桃花说着，就去自己的床上睡了。
杨桃花也是没有的怀疑，只是觉得这傻徒儿比之前懂事了不少。
这让杨桃花是欣慰，只是到了晚上，她也煎熬。
柳大春也回了自己的房间，关了灯，坐了下来，开始修行《伏羲正阴》里的阳术，所谓阳术就是修炼男性的根基。
这也是锦鳞蚺采阴修魔的前提基础条件。
柳大春运气，把魔气都转移到核心地方，专门修行根基。
很快，柳大春就进入了一种特殊的境界，四周鸟语花香，天空海洋，美人如云。
这种美梦那是极好的，美梦也无比的真实。
柳大春发现自己变成了一条巨大的锦鳞蚺，游离在人间，人中龙凤。

> Chapter 17 Foundation (Page 1)
"Master Wife, how did we take a bath before?" Liu Dachun asked with a silly smile.
"No, it must be because I'm ignorant. Master, let me give you a bath." Liu Dachun said deliberately.
"Ah? You stupid disciple, why do you suddenly show respect to your master's wife? Well, you can rub it for your master's wife." Master's wife Yang Taohua said, turning her body sideways, with her back to Liu Dachun.
Liu Dachun lay down and stretched out his hands to give the mistress a bath, first rubbing his shoulders and then working his way down.
Master Yang Taohua screamed, looked back at Silly Tuer, and asked: "Silly Tuer, where are you rubbing?"
"Ah? Rub them all clean." Liu Dachun replied.
"Just rub Master's back." Master Yang Taohua replied.
"Oh, rub the back, rub the front, and rub the front too." Liu Dachun said and continued to rub.
Master Yang Taohua turned around, looked at Liu Dachun, and asked: "Silly Dachun, you didn't do it on purpose, did you?"
"Ah? What are you doing on purpose?" Liu Dachun hurriedly pretended to be stupid.
"Haha, you are not interested in women anymore, are you?" Master Yang Taohua asked with a smile.
"Well, I like to rub Master's wife here, hehe." Liu Dachun admitted immediately. Anyway, he was a fool, and Master's wife would not blame him.
"You idiot, haven't you grown up?" Yang Taohua, the teacher's wife, said, looked at it, and smiled with a disappointed look on her face: "You are still an idiot, rub your back, don't rub your front, it's annoying."
"Why can't Master Wife rub the front?" Liu Dachun asked pretending not to understand.
"When you become a man one day, you will understand." Yang Taohua, the master's wife, said with a smile.
That bastard Wu Kun had harmed him like this, and he had to take revenge.
Well, I will devote all my energy to cultivating Zhengyang Qi tonight, and I will definitely be able to recover, otherwise even my master wife will not be interested in me at all.
Thinking of this, Liu Dachun wanted to die, but he was powerless.
Liu Dachun took a bath early, carried the big wooden bucket back, and then returned to his room.
The rooms of Liu Dachun and his wife Yang Taohua were connected together, with a curtain covering the middle.
"Silly disciple, aren't you going to sleep with the master's wife tonight?" The master's wife Yang Taohua was wearing a nightgown, showing off her graceful and plump figure.
"Well, Master's wife, I have something to do tonight, so I'll sleep in the next room by myself." Liu Dachun thought, if he can't restore his male ejaculation, sleeping with Master's wife will only be a kind of torture.
"That's okay, you've grown up too." Yang Taohua, the master's wife, said and went to sleep in her own bed.
Yang Taohua had no doubts, but she felt that this idiot was much more sensible than before.
This made Yang Taohua happy, but at night, she was also suffering.
Liu Dachun also returned to his room, turned off the lights, sat down, and began to practice the Yang technique in "Fuxi Zhengyin". The so-called Yang technique is the foundation of male cultivation.
This is also the prerequisite for the golden-scaled anaconda to collect yin and cultivate demons.
Liu Dachun was lucky enough to transfer all the demonic energy to the core, specializing in cultivating the foundation.
Soon, Liu Dachun entered a special realm, surrounded by birds singing and flowers fragrant, the sky ocean, and beauties like clouds.
This kind of dream is wonderful, and the dream is also extremely real.
Liu Dachun found that he had turned into a giant anaconda, wandering around the world, like a dragon or a phoenix among people.
